property.name: HasFogVertexClamped
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device clamps fog blend factor per vertex.
property.value: true if the device clamps fog blend factor per vertex; false otherwise.

property.name: IsNullReference
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device is a null reference device that does not render.
property.value: true if the device is a null reference device; false otherwise.

property.name: SupportsBlendOperation
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports blending operations other than BlendFunction.Add.
property.value: true if the driver supports other blend operations; false otherwise.

property.name: SupportsClipPlaneScaledPoints
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device correctly clips scaled points of size greater than 1.0 to user-defined clipping planes.
property.value: true if the device correctly clips scaled points; false otherwise.

property.name: SupportsClipTransformedVertices
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device clips post-transformed vertex primitives.
property.value: true if the device clips post-transformed vertex primitives; false otherwise.
property.remarks: Specify ResourceUsage.DoNotClip when the pipeline should not do any clipping. For this case, additional software clipping may need to be performed at draw time, requiring the vertex buffer to be in system memory.

property.name: SupportsColorWrite
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports per-channel writes for the render-target color buffer through the ColorWriteChannels state.
property.value: true if the device supports per-channel writes; false otherwise.

property.name: SupportsCullClockwiseFace
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the driver supports clockwise triangle culling through the CullMode state.
property.value: true if the driver supports clockwise triangle culling; false otherwise.
property.remarks: This applies only to triangle primitives.

property.name: SupportsCullCounterClockwiseFace
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the driver supports counterclockwise triangle culling through the CullMode state.
property.value: true if the driver supports counterclockwise triangle culling; false otherwise.
property.remarks: This applies only to triangle primitives.

property.name: SupportsCullNone
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the driver does not perform triangle culling.
property.value: true if the driver does not perform triangle culling; false otherwise.

property.name: SupportsFogAndSpecularAlpha
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the driver supports separate fog and specular alpha.
property.value: true if the driver supports separate fog and specular alpha; false otherwise.
property.remarks: Many devices use the specular alpha channel to store the fog factor.

property.name: SupportsIndependentWriteMasks
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports independent write masks for multiple element textures or multiple render targets.
property.value: true if the device supports independent write masks; false otherwise.

property.name: SupportsMaskZ
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device can enable and disable modification of the depth buffer on pixel operations.
property.value: true if the device can enable and disable modification of the depth buffer; false otherwise.

property.name: SupportsMultipleRenderTargetsIndependentBitDepths
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports different bit depths for multiple render targets.
property.value: true if the device supports different bit depths for multiple render targets; false otherwise.

property.name: SupportsMultipleRenderTargetsPostPixelShaderBlending
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports post-pixel shader operations for multiple render targets.
property.value: true if the device supports post-pixel shader operations for multiple render targets; false otherwise.

property.name: SupportsPerStageConstant
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports per-stage constants.
property.value: true if the device supports per-stage constants; false otherwise.

property.name: SupportsSeparateAlphaBlend
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports separate blend settings for the alpha channel.
property.value: true if the device supports separate blend settings for the alpha channel; false otherwise.

property.name: SupportsTextureStageStateArgumentTemp
property.summary: Gets a value indicating whether the device supports texture argument values for the temporary register.
property.value: true if the device supports texture argument values for the temporary register; false otherwise.

method.name: ToString
method.summary: Retrieves a string representation of this object.

overload.summary: Retrieves a string representation of this object.
